author: Urgaash
quote: This Game is so Overhyped and Overrated. It is 80$ base with Content locket behind a Paywall for the full game you have to pay 100$. 400$ for a Collectors Edition without a Game, this is just ripping the GTA Fans off and I am not Even a Fan telling you this if you are one. So lets do some math 100$ for a Game 400$ for a Collectors Edition if you are really invested and a Fan and then up to 1500$ for the Console to play it in the First place. Oh did I mentioned that it is digital only, just a Key so you not own this at some Point Sony could decide to take it away because they feel like it. Honestly this game has so many red Flaggs, do yourself a Favor and do not buy it.
